title: Implementation of Recommendations by 2021 National Wellness Committee on Junior Doctors
what_it_is: Implementation of Recommendations by 2021 National Wellness Committee on Junior Doctors

sections.label: Junior doctors' well-being efforts
sections.summary: MOH states it continues efforts to improve and retain doctors, citing the National Wellness Committee for Junior Doctors, Chief Wellness Officers and the Hospital Clinician scheme.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Nevertheless, we continue to make efforts to improve the well-being of our doctors and to retain them in public service, including the formation of the National Wellness Committee for Junior Doctors (NWC-JD) which has been studying initiatives to promote and improve the well-being of junior doctors in the public healthcare system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The committee is conducting a series of in-depth small group discussions with junior and senior doctors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Through these, we have sought to validate the approach to key concerns such as the need to improve career pathways, address work hours and improve work conditions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The committee is concluding its engagements with stakeholders and finalising its recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Early initiatives already in place include the appointment of Chief Wellness Officers in our public healthcare clusters.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: These officers have a responsibility to enhance the well-being of all healthcare staff.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have also begun to expand and refine career pathways, such as the introduction of the Hospital Clinician scheme to provide doctors with more diverse career options.

sections.label: Conducive work environment for junior doctors
sections.summary: MOH is asked whether it will consider reducing paperwork and streamlining admin processes, and says it monitors workload via electronic logging and surveys.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry of Health (MOH) consider initiatives, such as reducing paperwork and streamlining some of the admin processes, to make a more conducive work environment for our junior doctors?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are doing electronic logging and surveys to monitor the workload of junior doctors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: However, the issue goes beyond just the simple redistribution of workload or the simplistic hiring of more manpower.
